events.continuity_hook: Adds a final practical timing and parking check to the already booked Santa Fe personal weekend.
events.interaction_goal: Update the compact weekend itinerary with the revised dinner and check-in details while leaving the booked flights, car, and inn unchanged.
events.scenario_brief: The Santa Fe weekend is already booked, but the inn confirms a tighter check-in window and limited on-site parking, and the Saturday dinner reservation shifts earlier. Jonah does not want to revisit the flights or hotel; he only needs the Albuquerque rental-car pickup, drive timing to Santa Fe, parking note, dinner timing, and seating-together check tightened. The quiet king room and mini-fridge remain requests rather than must-haves.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a new conference-planning episode after the Santa Fe weekend details are settled.
events.interaction_goal: Build a flight and hotel shortlist that protects Monday setup while showing the trade-offs between the official block, nearby hotel quality, and possible return timing.
events.scenario_brief: Jonah receives his exhibitor assignment for a Denver water-technology conference: badge pickup is Monday at noon, booth setup is Monday afternoon, and he has an early Tuesday panel. He needs Bay Area-to-Denver flight options that protect the setup window, with a Sunday afternoon departure if the company approves the extra night and a Monday morning fallback only if it is low-risk. Hotel choices should compare the official convention block against better-rated nearby business hotels, with restaurant access, guest feedback, and room basics visible. The unresolved items are Sunday-night approval and whether he must stay through Thursday teardown.

events.continuity_hook: Continues the Denver conference episode after the exhibitor schedule and travel approval become clearer.
events.interaction_goal: Narrow the flight, return window, and hotel choice around the crate inspection, reception, and teardown schedule.
events.scenario_brief: The company approves a Sunday arrival, but the conference packet adds an 11:00 a.m. Monday crate inspection and a Wednesday evening customer reception. That makes Monday arrival too risky and keeps a Wednesday-night return unattractive. Jonah wants to narrow the flight choice between a Sunday afternoon United nonstop from SFO and a lower-cost Oakland option with less convenient timing, then compare the remaining official-block room against a higher-rated nearby hotel with easier breakfast and dinner options. The remaining open item is whether teardown ends early enough for a Thursday afternoon return or needs a Thursday evening flight.

events.continuity_hook: Moves the Denver conference trip from comparison to booking once teardown timing is settled.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the conference flights, hotel booking, room notes, seat selections, and concise booth-schedule itinerary.
events.scenario_brief: The organizer confirms teardown should finish by mid-afternoon Thursday. Jonah books the Sunday afternoon SFO-to-Denver nonstop and a Thursday evening return, selects the higher-rated hotel a short walk or rideshare from the convention center instead of the remaining block room, and wants the reservation to request a coffee maker and mini-fridge. Seat selection should use window seats where available, and the itinerary should show badge pickup, crate inspection, customer reception, and teardown windows.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a new client-site episode after the Denver conference booking is complete.
events.interaction_goal: Create a flight, rental-car, and hotel shortlist that protects the Thursday site start while leaving room for the possible Friday debrief.
events.scenario_brief: A Boise-area municipal utility asks Jonah to join a pilot-skid acceptance review at 8:00 a.m. Thursday, with an optional Friday operator debrief depending on whether the media shipment clears receiving. He needs Wednesday Bay Area-to-Boise flight options arriving early enough to pick up a rental car and review site notes, with clean routing more important than carrier. Hotels should compare Meridian or Nampa convenience near the plant against downtown Boise dining and stronger evening options, while keeping guest feedback, parking, and early-start room basics in view. The unresolved item is whether to return Thursday evening or Friday afternoon.

events.continuity_hook: Moves the Boise utility pilot-acceptance trip from open-ended planning to booking after the Friday debrief is confirmed.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize the flights, rental car, hotel reservation, room request, seat selections, and two-day site itinerary.
events.scenario_brief: The utility confirms the media shipment will be on site and locks the Friday 10:00 a.m. operator debrief, so Jonah keeps two hotel nights and returns Friday afternoon. He chooses the better-timed Wednesday afternoon SFO-to-Boise nonstop even though it is not the favored carrier option, books a compact rental car, and selects the Meridian hotel because it shortens the Thursday drive while still having solid guest feedback, parking, and nearby dinner choices. The room note should request a coffee maker and mini-fridge, and window seats should be chosen where available.
